title: Cycle Scan Request (POST /v1/cycles)
description: Additive calculation-service endpoint. POST /v1/calculate is unchanged. The request carries natal LONGITUDES, never birth data: transit-to-natal contacts need nothing else, so the calculation service never acquires a decryption path and the 'birth stays encrypted at rest' invariant survives the new surface untouched. The object is closed, which is the enforcement — a user id, birth instant, timezone, coordinate, profile id, or storage id is rejected because it is not declared.

scanWindow.description: A SELECTION interval, not permission to clip an encounter. A cycle is returned when its complete orb envelope intersects [from, to); the scanner then evaluates beyond both boundaries across adjacent stations and orb roots until the first entry, every exact pass, and the final exit are known.

natal_positions.description: Under unknown effective accuracy, ascendant and midheaven must not appear: those targets are never computed rather than computed and filtered.

natal_accuracy.description: The EFFECTIVE accuracy the chart engine recomputed, not the label the original caller sent.

suppressed_features.description: When it contains moon_time_sensitive, natal Moon targets are omitted. A TRANSITING Moon remains valid against stable natal targets, because the transit instant is known even when the birth instant is not.

techniques.description: Launch scope. stations_ingresses and lunations_eclipses stay declared-but-absent in the M0 calculation contract; this document does not widen that claim.
